#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool;
use te1_chess::{START_FEN, Te1Game};
use te1_search::{search, SearchLimits, SearchOptions, SearchResult};
use te1_tt::TranspositionTable;

struct Spec {
    id: &'static str,
    fen: &'static str,
    moves: &'static str,
}

const DEPTH: u8 = 7;
const POSITIONS: &[Spec] = &[
    Spec { id: "startpos", fen: START_FEN, moves: "" },
    Spec { id: "ruy_lopez", fen: START_FEN, moves: "e2e4 e7e5 g1f3 b8c6 f1b5 a7a6 b5a4 g8f6 e1g1 f8e7" },
    Spec { id: "nimzo_indian", fen: START_FEN, moves: "d2d4 g8f6 c2c4 e7e6 b1c3 f8b4 e2e3 e8g8 f1d3 d7d5" },
    Spec { id: "sicilian_classical", fen: START_FEN, moves: "e2e4 c7c5 g1f3 d7d6 d2d4 c5d4 f3d4 g8f6 b1c3 b8c6" },
    Spec { id: "queens_gambit", fen: START_FEN, moves: "d2d4 d7d5 c2c4 e7e6 b1c3 g8f6 c1g5 f8e7 e2e3 e8g8" },
    Spec { id: "caro_kann_advance", fen: START_FEN, moves: "e2e4 c7c6 d2d4 d7d5 e4e5 c8f5 g1f3 e7e6 f1e2" },
    Spec { id: "english_four_knights", fen: START_FEN, moves: "c2c4 e7e5 b1c3 g8f6 g1f3 b8c6 g2g3 f8b4 f1g2 e8g8" },
    Spec { id: "kings_indian", fen: START_FEN, moves: "d2d4 g8f6 c2c4 g7g6 b1c3 f8g7 e2e4 d7d6 g1f3 e8g8" },
    Spec { id: "kiwipete_family", fen: "r3k2r/p1ppqpb1/bn2pnp1/2pP4/1p2P3/2N2N2/PPQBBPPP/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1", moves: "" },
    Spec { id: "quiet_middlegame", fen: "2r2rk1/pp1nbppp/2p1pn2/q2p4/3P4/2N1PN2/PPQ1BPPP/2RR2K1 w - - 0 1", moves: "" },
];

fn make_game(spec: &Spec) -> Te1Game {
    let mut game = Te1Game::from_fen(spec.fen).unwrap();
    for mv in spec.moves.split_whitespace() {
        game.play_uci(mv).unwrap();
    }
    game
}

fn run(game: &Te1Game, table: Arc<TranspositionTable>) -> SearchResult {
    search(
        game,
        SearchLimits { depth: Some(DEPTH), ..SearchLimits::default() },
        Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
        table,
        SearchOptions {
            threads: 1,
            deterministic: true,
            use_lmr: true,
            use_see_pruning: true,
            use_null_move_pruning: true,
        },
    ).unwrap()
}

fn semantic(r: &SearchResult) -> String {
    format!("{}|{}|{}|{}", r.best_move.as_deref().unwrap_or("0000"), r.score_cp, r.depth, r.pv.join(","))
}

fn main() {
    for mb in [1usize, 16, 128] {
        let table = TranspositionTable::with_megabytes(mb);
        println!("TE1_S2_TT_CAPACITY mb={mb} entries={}", table.len());
    }

    let mut cold_total = 0u64;
    let mut warm_total = 0u64;
    for spec in POSITIONS {
        let game = make_game(spec);
        let table = Arc::new(TranspositionTable::with_megabytes(16));
        let cold = run(&game, Arc::clone(&table));
        let warm = run(&game, Arc::clone(&table));
        assert_eq!(semantic(&warm), semantic(&cold), "warm TT semantic drift for {}", spec.id);
        assert!(warm.nodes < cold.nodes, "warm TT failed to reduce nodes for {}: warm={} cold={}", spec.id, warm.nodes, cold.nodes);
        cold_total = cold_total.saturating_add(cold.nodes);
        warm_total = warm_total.saturating_add(warm.nodes);
        println!(
            "TE1_S2_TT_UTILITY id={} depth={} cold_nodes={} warm_nodes={} saved={} cold_tthits={} warm_tthits={} semantic={}",
            spec.id,
            DEPTH,
            cold.nodes,
            warm.nodes,
            cold.nodes.saturating_sub(warm.nodes),
            cold.tt_hits,
            warm.tt_hits,
            semantic(&cold),
        );
    }
    assert!(warm_total < cold_total);
    println!(
        "TE1_S2_TT_UTILITY_SUMMARY positions={} depth={} cold_total={} warm_total={} saved={} warm_per_mille={}",
        POSITIONS.len(),
        DEPTH,
        cold_total,
        warm_total,
        cold_total.saturating_sub(warm_total),
        warm_total.saturating_mul(1000) / cold_total.max(1),
    );
}
